details:
# AstroVital – Monitoring Health Beyond Earth

AstroVital is an AI-powered, offline-first astronaut health monitoring platform designed to make space missions safer and healthier.

It connects astronauts and Earth-based medical officers through two interactive dashboards. Astronauts can track daily health parameters such as heart rate, oxygen levels, body temperature, sleep, symptoms and vision clarity. Gemini AI analyzes recorded data to generate weekly health insights and identify unusual changes from personal health baselines.

The platform also monitors spacecraft cabin temperature and simulated neutron radiation data, provides emergency alerts, and stores health records offline with automatic synchronization when connectivity returns.

**Key Innovations:**

- AI-powered weekly health intelligence using Gemini.

- Personal health baseline and trend monitoring.

- Vision clarity tracking.

- Spacecraft environmental monitoring.

- Offline-first data storage and synchronization.

- Instant emergency alert system.

**Technologies Used:** HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Gemini API, IndexedDB, PWA and interactive data visualization.

**Intended Impact:** To improve astronaut safety, support timely medical decisions and make long-duration space missions more reliable.

**Our Vision:** *Because exploring beyond Earth should never mean compromising the health of those who explore it.*
